headline: Aditya Birla Sun Life AMC launches GIFT City funds
hook: New global access via GIFT City
summary: Aditya Birla Sun Life AMC has launched new funds in GIFT City aimed at both domestic and international investors. The move provides expanded cross-border investment channels from the Gujarat financial hub. Retail investors gain alternative avenues for global portfolio diversification through these new fund offerings. This development broadens the financial product suite available within India's premier international financial services centre.
why_it_matters: New global investment options open up through GIFT City funds.
winners_losers: ABSLAMC gains / traditional domestic fund managers unaffected

headline: US bond yields pose risk to expensive Indian small and mid-caps
hook: Rising US yields threaten Indian mid-cap valuations
summary: Harish Krishnan of Aditya Birla Sun Life AMC warns that rising US Treasury yields could disproportionately impact the valuations of Indian mid-cap and small-cap stocks. He emphasizes that investors should prioritize fundamental quality, such as cash flows and return on capital, over current market momentum. The shift in global interest rates may force a re-rating of expensive stocks that have outperformed recently. Retail investors are advised to focus on earnings-backed growth rather than speculative price trends.
why_it_matters: High-valuation mid-cap holdings may face significant price corrections.
winners_losers: Quality stocks gain / Expensive mid-caps hurt
